info.description:
ARCHIVAL COLLECTION: these generated scenarios predate the database-backed permission migration and must be regenerated before execution against the current API. Use docs/API_SPEC.md and docs/AUTHORIZATION_MATRIX.md as the current contract. Legacy role/roles/ROLE_* fields in these historical scenarios are not accepted by the current API.

Note on OAuth2: Endpoints GET /api/v1/auth/oauth/google/artisan and GET /api/v1/auth/oauth/google/client require interactive browser navigation and Google consent redirects, so they cannot be executed via automated Postman requests.
